action_conditioning: current interaction always true can open adjacent door; attempted enemy law otherwise independent of action
fitting_regime_weight_interpretation: Equal episode counts across regimes; fitting/subvalidation minimizes pooled target loss, so effective target weights follow recorded exposure rather than exactly one third.
forecast_target: at least one enemy at each origin-relative grid coordinate after the next enemy tick
frozen_variant: same source and initial logits; evaluator sets learn=False, only transition-logit updates stop
known_law_variant: same source and partial-observation state; evaluator provides current nine probabilities only
limitations: anonymous occupancy approximation cannot identify overlapping enemies
unseen terrain uses observed map and gen14 occupancy belief; not an exact POMDP filter
fit subvalidation is development and is selection-biased
online updates use Brier gradients, not privileged movement labels
manual_changes: replace ten gen14 transition features with nine absolute attempted-direction logits
aggregate blocked-attempt probability at source, including illegal corner diagonals
anonymous union-occupancy Brier-gradient update and independently development-fitted initial logits
optional privileged current-law observation for known-law reference; same planner
online_update: Per-observation anonymous occupancy Brier gradient; rate2.0; per-coordinate gradient clipped[-0.5,0.5], ridge pull0.002 toward fitted prior; center and clip logits[-5,5].
online_variant: same source and initial logits; evaluator sets learn=True
planning_risk: immediate exported one-tick occupancy; continuation is inherited survival-conditioned two-tick collision heuristic; neither equals total death probability
private_inputs: Existing results/private/v3-fit-seeds.json and v3-fit-validation-seeds.json; never assessment cases
role: manually engineered comparator, not the new evolutionary seed
